name: How can I prevent my kitchen sink from clogging?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent my kitchen sink from clogging?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preventing kitchen sink clogs involves mindful habits. Always scrape food scraps into the trash before washing dishes; avoid pouring grease, oil, or fat down the drain, as it solidifies and builds up over time. Use a drain screen or strainer to catch food particles. Run hot water after using the sink to help flush away residues, and consider pouring a mixture of baking soda and vinegar down the drain periodically as a natural cleaning method to help break down minor buildup. Proper disposal of waste is key to keeping drains clear.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent clogs by avoiding grease and food scraps down the drain, using a drain strainer, and running hot water regularly.
